name: IBY_EXTERNAL_PAYEES_ALL_
description: IBY_EXTERNAL_PAYEES_ALL stores payment-related attributes for the funds disbursement payment process for external party payees. This table corresponds to the supplier attributes.

columns.name: EXT_PAYEE_ID
columns.description: System-generated primary key.

columns.name: PAYEE_PARTY_ID
columns.description: TCA party Identifier

columns.name: PAYMENT_FUNCTION
columns.description: Function or purpose of the payment. Values from the lookup IBY_PAYMENT_FUNCTIONS include SUPPLIER_PAYMENT, CUSTOMER_REFUNDS, and others.

columns.name: EXCLUSIVE_PAYMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether documents payable for this payee should be prevented from being grouped with other like documents payable for payment.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PARTY_SITE_ID
columns.description: Party site Identifier

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE_ID
columns.description: Supplier site Identifier

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: ORG_TYPE
columns.description: Organization type, such as business unit. Values taken from lookup: IBY_ORGANIZATION_TYPES

columns.name: DEFAULT_PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Default payment method Identifier

columns.name: ECE_TP_LOCATION_CODE
columns.description: Trading partner location code for e-Commerce Gateway

columns.name: BANK_CHARGE_BEARER
columns.description: Party that is responsible for paying regular or express bank charges, such as Payee or Payer. Values taken from lookup: IBY_BANK_CHARGE_BEARER

columns.name: BANK_INSTRUCTION1_CODE
columns.description: Code of first bank instruction

columns.name: BANK_INSTRUCTION2_CODE
columns.description: Code of second bank instruction

columns.name: BANK_INSTRUCTION_DETAILS
columns.description: Additional bank instruction details

columns.name: PAYMENT_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Payment reason code

columns.name: PAYMENT_REASON_COMMENTS
columns.description: Free text field available for entering a reason for the payment

columns.name: INACTIVE_DATE
columns.description: web service java client proxy

columns.name: PAYMENT_TEXT_MESSAGE1
columns.description: Text message for use in payment processing

columns.name: PAYMENT_TEXT_MESSAGE2
columns.description: Text message for use in payment processing

columns.name: PAYMENT_TEXT_MESSAGE3
columns.description: Text message for use in payment processing

columns.name: DELIVERY_CHANNEL_CODE
columns.description: Default delivery channel code

columns.name: LOCAL_INSTRUMENT_CODE
columns.description: Default Local Instrument Code

columns.name: SERVICE_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Default Service Level Code

columns.name: PAYMENT_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Default payment format code

columns.name: SETTLEMENT_PRIORITY
columns.description: Priority with which the financial institution or payment system settles payments for this payee. The available values for this column come from the FND lookup IBY_SETTLEMENT_PRIORITY.

columns.name: REMIT_ADVICE_DELIVERY_METHOD
columns.description: Default delivery method set on the payee level.  If the Override with Payee Delivery Method Preference flag on the Payment Process Profile is turned off, the setting here is ignored. Values from the lookup IBY_DELIVERY_METHODS include EMAIL, FAX, and PRINTED.

columns.name: REMIT_ADVICE_EMAIL
columns.description: E-mail address at which the payee wishes to receive remittance advice

columns.name: REMIT_ADVICE_FAX
columns.description: Fax number at which the payee wishes to receive remittance advice

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date when the payee record becomes inactive.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date when the payee record becomes active.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Enterprise identifier to support multi-tenancy.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Actione Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1's and 0s for each row. 1 will be stored if the value has changed and 0 will be stored if the value hasn't.
